- `client-2` (TID 648687): 5,605 waits, 3,198.1 ms total; mean 0.571 ms, longest 25.759 ms.

These were waits for received packets. `recvfrom` showed an occasional long tail (p99 24.777 ms, maximum 26.776 ms), but the trace attributes the packet wake-ups to the local `kvd` process. Four connections to another host were attempted and connected, with only 0.180 ms of connect-wait time in total. The trace does not record the destination addresses, so it cannot identify those hosts.
